paragraphs.en: This setting is more challenging than the SDO /AIA-to- Hinode /SOT-SP task for two main reasons. First, the available EUV passbands primarily originate in the chromosphere, transition region, and corona rather than the photosphere, thus provide only indirect constraints on the photospheric magnetic field. Second, neither STEREO nor GOES provides vector magnetogram measurements, and Hinode /SOT-SP does not provide sufficiently dense co-observations to construct paired training sets. Because true STEREO /EUVI far-side predictions cannot be directly validated without simultaneous far-side vector magnetograms, we evaluate the model in a proxy setting in which magnetic supervision is available: we use periods when each EUV instrument has substantial field-of-view overlap with SDO /HMI, generate SuperSynthIA vector magnetograms from the corresponding SDO /HMI Stokes observations, and reproject these magnetograms onto the coordinate grid of the respective instrument. These reprojected SuperSynthIA magnetograms are used as the fine-tuning target and the validation reference. This proxy experiment provides a way to validate whether MAGiDiff can generalize to other EUV instruments and recover vector magnetograms from their EUV observations.
paragraphs.zh: 与 SDO /AIA-to-Hinode /SOT-SP 任务相比，这项设置更具挑战性，主要有两个原因。 首先，可用的 EUV 通带主要源自色球层、过渡区和日冕，而非光球层，因此只能对光球层的磁场提供间接约束。 其次，STEREO 和 GOES 均未提供矢量磁图测量数据，而 Hinode /SOT-SP 也未提供足够密集的同步观测数据来构建成对的训练集。 由于没有同步的远侧矢量磁图，无法直接验证真正的 STEREO /EUVI 远侧预测结果，因此我们采用一种代理设置来评估该模型：在这种设置中，磁场监督是可行的。我们使用各 EUV 仪器与 SDO /HMI 存在显著视场重叠的时间段，从相应的 SDO /HMI Stokes 观测数据生成 SuperSynthIA 矢量磁图，并将这些磁图重新投影到各自仪器的坐标网格上。 这些经过重新投影的 SuperSynthIA 磁图被用作微调目标和验证参考。 这项代理实验提供了一种验证方法，用于确认 MAGiDiff 是否能够推广到其他 EUV 仪器，并能够从它们的 EUV 观测数据中恢复出矢量磁图。

paragraphs.en: We adapt MAGiDiff to each instrument using a two-stage fine-tuning procedure. First, we fine-tune the VAE on SuperSynthIA magnetograms so that the latent space better matches the target magnetogram distribution. Second, we fine-tune two separate denoising U-Nets for STEREO /EUVI and GOES /SUVI on their corresponding instrument-specific dataset while keeping the VAE frozen. The base model that is fine-tuned upon is trained with the resolution-adjusted noise schedule described in Section IV.7 . The resulting full-disk prediction generation also follows the tiled inference procedure. The detailed fine-tuning procedure is provided in Section C.4 .
paragraphs.zh: 我们采用两阶段微调流程，将 MAGiDiff 适配到每种仪器。 首先，我们在 SuperSynthIA 磁图数据上对 VAE 进行微调，使潜在空间能更好地匹配目标磁图分布。 其次，在保持 VAE 冻结的同时，我们针对 STEREO /EUVI 和 GOES /SUVI 分别在其对应的仪器专用数据集上微调两个独立的去噪 U-Net。 用于微调的基础模型是依据第 IV.7 节中描述的分辨率调整噪声调度方案训练得到的。 由此生成的全日面预测结果也遵循分块推理流程。 详细的微调流程见第 C.4 节。

paragraphs.en: We show qualitative results in Figure 11 , which presents full-disk α ​ B R \alpha B_{R} predictions from the fine-tuned STEREO /EUVI and GOES /SUVI models. We evaluate the models on data from 2024 February 22, 04:12 TAI, which falls within the test-set time range and is selected because the STEREO /EUVI field of view has substantial overlap with both SDO /HMI and GOES /SUVI. Across all three instruments, MAGiDiff recovers the dominant active-region magnetic structure and produces full-disk predictions that broadly resemble the SuperSynthIA reference. Some disagreement remains in extended plage regions, where a bipolar structure may be predicted as unipolar, consistent with the limitation discussed in Section IV.7 .
paragraphs.zh: 我们在图 11 中展示了定性结果，该图呈现了经过微调的 STEREO/EUVI 和 GOES/SUVI 模型对全日面 α_BR（αB_R）的预测。 我们使用 2024 年 2 月 22 日 04:12 TAI 的数据对模型进行了评估，该数据位于测试集的时间范围内，并且被选中是因为 STEREO/EUVI 的视场与 SDO/HMI 和 GOES/SUVI 均有显著重叠。 在所有三种仪器中，MAGiDiff 都恢复了主导的活跃区磁结构，并生成了与 SuperSynthIA 参考结果大致相似的全日面预测。 在扩展的光斑区域中仍存在一定差异，在这些区域中，双极结构可能会被预测为单极结构，这与第 IV.7 节中讨论的局限性一致。

paragraphs.en: We additionally assess the distributional agreement between these full-disk predictions and the SuperSynthIA reference in Figure 19 . Because the predictions are inferred solely from EUV observations acquired by different instruments, whereas the SuperSynthIA reference is derived from SDO /HMI observations and reprojected onto each instrument’s respective coordinate grid, exact pixel-accurate correspondence is impossible. We therefore examine the pixel-value distributions to assess whether the models recover the overall distribution of magnetic field values. Across all instruments and field components, the predicted distributions broadly follow the corresponding SuperSynthIA distribution, with slight underestimation at strong field strengths, particularly for α ​ B ϕ \alpha B_{\phi} and α ​ B θ \alpha B_{\theta} .
paragraphs.zh: 我们还评估了这些全日面预测与图 19 中的 SuperSynthIA 参考数据之间的分布一致性。 由于这些预测完全基于不同仪器获取的 EUV 观测数据推断得出，而 SuperSynthIA 参考数据则源自 SDO/HMI 观测并重新投影到各仪器的相应坐标网格上，因此无法实现像素级的精确对应。 因此，我们检查了像素值分布，以评估模型是否能够恢复磁场值的整体分布。 在所有仪器和场分量中，预测的分布大致遵循相应的 SuperSynthIA 分布，但在强场强度处存在轻微的低估，尤其是在 α B_φ 和 α B_θ 方面。

paragraphs.en: To isolate the effect of full-disk domain gap, we compare two inference settings in Figure 12 : applying MAGiDiff to the full-disk EUV input and then cropping the predicted magnetogram afterward, versus applying MAGiDiff directly to the corresponding EUV cutout. With tiled full-disk inference, the two settings produce similar results in both regions, and both recover the dominant magnetic structures well. The zoom-ins also explain the underestimation of strong-field α ​ B ϕ \alpha B_{\phi} and α ​ B θ \alpha B_{\theta} pixels for the two GOES /SUVI predictions in Figure 19 . In both inference settings, MAGiDiff predicts a smaller sunspot than SuperSynthIA, resulting in substantial field strength underestimation for pixels near the sunspot boundary. This underestimation of the size of the active region is not too surprising, since the GOES /SUVI instruments only provide EUV information and have limited direct information about the photosphere. Nonetheless, the results demonstrate that tiled inference can extend the method across the full disk. More broadly, while the size of the active region in the GOES /SUVI data is smaller, its general shape and configuration are consistent with SuperSynthIA. Thus, the results suggest that MAGiDiff can be applied to a variety of UV/EUV instruments to produce estimates of the vector magnetic field.

paragraphs.en: We present MAGiDiff , a new approach to estimate photospheric vector magnetic field directly from UV/EUV intensity maps using a deep learning model. MAGiDiff is built upon the latent diffusion model and is trained on co-registered SDO /AIA and Hinode /SOT-SP observations with 14 14 years of data. Inspired by prior works [ 36 , 30 , 64 ] , we extend the focus beyond line-of-sight magnetograms to the full heliographic vector magnetic field components α ​ B R \alpha B_{R} , α ​ B ϕ \alpha B_{\phi} , α ​ B θ \alpha B_{\theta} . Qualitative and quantitative evaluations show that MAGiDiff produces visually-plausible magnetograms. In cutouts, MAGiDiff predictions show strong agreement with Hinode /SOT-SP, capturing both the large-scale structure and fine details.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 MAGiDiff，这是一种利用深度学习模型直接从紫外/极紫外强度图中估算光球层矢量磁场的新型方法。 MAGiDiff 基于潜在扩散模型构建，并在经过配准的 SDO /AIA 和 Hinode /SOT-SP 观测数据（涵盖 14 年数据）上进行训练。 受先前研究 [36, 30, 64] 的启发，我们将研究重点从视线方向磁图扩展到了完整的日面矢量磁场分量 α B_R、α B_φ 和 α B_θ。 定性和定量评估表明，MAGiDiff 生成的磁图在视觉上具有合理性。 在局部裁剪图像中，MAGiDiff 的预测结果与 Hinode /SOT-SP 的数据高度一致，既捕捉到了大尺度结构，也还原了精细细节。

sents.en: We present MAGiDiff , a new approach to estimate photospheric vector magnetic field directly from UV/EUV intensity maps using a deep learning model.
sents.zh: 我们提出了 MAGiDiff，这是一种利用深度学习模型直接从紫外/极紫外强度图中估算光球层矢量磁场的新型方法。

sents.zh: MAGiDiff 基于潜在扩散模型构建，并在经过配准的 SDO /AIA 和 Hinode /SOT-SP 观测数据（涵盖 14 年数据）上进行训练。

sents.en: Inspired by prior works [ 36 , 30 , 64 ] , we extend the focus beyond line-of-sight magnetograms to the full heliographic vector magnetic field components α ​ B R \alpha B_{R} , α ​ B ϕ \alpha B_{\phi} , α ​ B θ \alpha B_{\theta} .
sents.zh: 受先前研究 [36, 30, 64] 的启发，我们将研究重点从视线方向磁图扩展到了完整的日面矢量磁场分量 α B_R、α B_φ 和 α B_θ。

paragraphs.en: We propose methods to probe the model beyond standard prediction to examine the richer physical information embedded in the model’s predictive distribution. We further demonstrate that MAGiDiff can be adapted to other EUV instruments and shows promising generalization across solar cycles. Full-disk experiments show that MAGiDiff can recover the main active-region magnetic structure beyond Hinode /SOT-SP-sized cutouts, while also revealing the need for additional global context to resolve domain gaps.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了一些方法，用于在标准预测之外探测模型，以检验模型预测分布中嵌入的更丰富的物理信息。 我们还进一步证明，MAGiDiff 可以适配其他 EUV 仪器，并在不同太阳周期中展现出良好的泛化能力。 全日面实验表明，MAGiDiff 能够恢复超出 Hinode /SOT-SP 尺寸裁剪范围的主要活动区磁结构，同时也揭示了需要更多全局上下文信息来解决域间间隙的问题。

paragraphs.en: Many of these results are credited to the breadth of data that is available for learning methods. Hinode /SOT-SP has provided nearly 19 years of high-quality data, and SDO /AIA has provided high-cadence, well-calibrated, full-disk filtergrams since 2010. This immense archive of data is absolutely critical for creating a high-quality dataset for training.
paragraphs.zh: 这些成果中的许多都得益于可用于学习方法的广泛数据。 Hinode /SOT-SP 提供了近 19 年的高质量数据，而 SDO /AIA 自 2010 年以来则提供了高时间分辨率、经过良好校准的全盘滤光图。 这个庞大的数据档案对于创建用于训练的高质量数据集至关重要。

sents.zh: 这些成果中的许多都得益于可用于学习方法的广泛数据。

paragraphs.en: Meanwhile, deep learning has unlocked huge potential in solar physics. Traditionally, vector magnetograms can only be inferred using inversion methods like [ 47 , 5 ] , which require high quality Stokes profiles. These full Stokes profiles are hard to acquire as a spectropolarimeter is required and typically can only be measured with limited cadence and coverage. By contrast, EUV intensity imaging is easier and therefore more common and spans over multiple solar cycles. Several studies have demonstrated that models can reasonably infer magnetograms from UV/EUV intensity images, despite the only statistical relationship between UV/EUV intensity and magnetic field maps. Among these efforts, [ 36 ] was the first to propose using a conditional GAN to estimate LOS magnetogram from EUV intensity images. Subsequent works - [ 30 , 10 , 64 , 33 , 16 , 44 , 29 , 31 ] - experimented with inputs from various instruments and introduced refinements to the GAN structure like incorporating temporal consistency and multi-channel conditioning. More recently, Ramunno et al. [51] , Ramunno et al. [52] , Xu et al. [72] bring diffusion into the field but their work primarily focuses on super-resolution of LOS magnetograms and conditional solar image generation. To the best of our knowledge, MAGiDiff is the first diffusion-based model to estimate full heliographic vector magnetic field end-to-end from EUV observations. We further probe the model to characterize the physical correlation it learns. We also test cross-instrument transfer to STEREO /EUVI and GOES /SUVI, where MAGiDiff shows good generalization ability, suggesting a potential extension to other similar instruments with careful calibration.
paragraphs.zh: 与此同时，深度学习在太阳物理学领域释放了巨大的潜力。 传统上，矢量磁图只能通过诸如 [47, 5] 之类的反演方法推断，而这些方法需要高质量的斯托克斯谱线。 这些完整的斯托克斯谱线难以获取，因为需要光谱偏振仪，而且通常只能以有限的频率和覆盖范围进行测量。 相比之下，EUV 强度成像更为简单，因此也更常见，并且覆盖了多个太阳周期。 多项研究已表明，尽管 UV/EUV 强度与磁场图之间仅存在统计关系，模型仍能从 UV/EUV 强度图像中合理推断出磁图。 在这些研究中，[36] 首次提出使用条件 GAN 从 EUV 强度图像中估计视线方向磁图。 后续研究——[30, 10, 64, 33, 16, 44, 29, 31]——尝试了来自不同仪器的输入，并对 GAN 结构进行了改进，例如引入时间一致性和多通道条件约束。 近期，Ramunno 等人 [51]、Ramunno 等人 [52]、Xu 等人 [72] 将扩散模型引入该领域，但他们的研究主要聚焦于视线方向磁图的超分辨率和条件太阳图像生成。 据我们所知，MAGiDiff 是首个基于扩散模型的端到端方法，能够从 EUV 观测数据中估计完整的日面矢量磁场。 我们进一步对模型进行了探究，以描述其学习到的物理相关性。 我们还测试了跨仪器迁移到 STEREO/EUVI 和 GOES/SUVI 的能力，结果表明 MAGiDiff 具有良好的泛化能力，这意味着经过仔细校准后，它可能能够扩展到其他类似仪器上。

sents.en: Meanwhile, deep learning has unlocked huge potential in solar physics.
sents.zh: 与此同时，深度学习在太阳物理学领域释放了巨大的潜力。

sents.zh: [72] 将扩散模型引入该领域，但他们的研究主要聚焦于视线方向磁图的超分辨率和条件太阳图像生成。

sents.en: To the best of our knowledge, MAGiDiff is the first diffusion-based model to estimate full heliographic vector magnetic field end-to-end from EUV observations.
sents.zh: 据我们所知，MAGiDiff 是首个基于扩散模型的端到端方法，能够从 EUV 观测数据中估计完整的日面矢量磁场。

sents.zh: 我们进一步对模型进行了探究，以描述其学习到的物理相关性。

sents.en: We also test cross-instrument transfer to STEREO /EUVI and GOES /SUVI, where MAGiDiff shows good generalization ability, suggesting a potential extension to other similar instruments with careful calibration.
sents.zh: 我们还测试了跨仪器迁移到 STEREO/EUVI 和 GOES/SUVI 的能力，结果表明 MAGiDiff 具有良好的泛化能力，这意味着经过仔细校准后，它可能能够扩展到其他类似仪器上。

paragraphs.en: Despite its strong performance, MAGiDiff naturally inherits several limitations due to its data-driven methodology. First, it depends critically on the accurate co-registration between SDO /AIA UV/EUV intensity map and Hinode /SOT-SP magnetograms. This is difficult as SDO /AIA captures data near instantaneously while Hinode /SOT-SP magnetograms are built up over tens of minutes. Such a temporal disparity means that UV/EUV observation can change dramatically while magnetogram data is being produced, leading to natural mismatch between the pairs. Second, MAGiDiff is trained on small, activity-focused cutouts. When applied at full-disk scale, this crop-based training can lead to artifacts like overly coherent unipolar large-scale plage. These failure modes suggest that full-disk prediction requires additional global context beyond what is available in the training cutouts. Third, although the model is provided with a polarity prior that should help resolve the polarity ambiguity, polarity errors can still occur. In many of these failure cases, different MAGiDiff realizations sample both the correct polarity solution and its sign-flipped counterpart. In other cases, however, the model consistently selects the opposite polarity. These cases indicate that resolving polarity remains imperfect in the current model and could be improved in future work.
paragraphs.zh: 尽管 MAGiDiff 表现强劲，但由于其数据驱动的方法论，它自然也继承了一些局限性。 首先，它严重依赖 SDO /AIA UV/EUV 强度图与 Hinode /SOT-SP 磁图之间的精确配准。 这很困难，因为 SDO /AIA 几乎能即时采集数据，而 Hinode /SOT-SP 磁图则需要数十分钟才能生成。 这种时间上的差异意味着，在磁图数据生成的过程中，UV/EUV 观测结果可能会发生剧烈变化，从而导致成对数据之间出现天然的错配。 其次，MAGiDiff 是在聚焦活动区域的小范围裁剪图像上进行训练的。 当将其应用于全日面尺度时，这种基于裁剪的训练可能会导致一些伪影，例如过度连贯的单极性大规模光斑。 这些失效模式表明，全日面预测需要超越训练裁剪图像所能提供的额外全局上下文信息。 第三，尽管模型获得了本应有助于解决极性模糊性的极性先验信息，但极性错误仍然可能发生。 在许多这类失效案例中，不同的 MAGiDiff 实现既会采样出正确的极性解，也会采样出符号翻转的对应解。 然而，在其他情况下，模型则会始终选择相反的极性。 这些案例表明，当前模型在解决极性问题上仍存在不足，未来工作或许可以对此进行改进。

paragraphs.en: Diffusion models lay the foundation for this work, and in this section we provide a concise overview of the underlying framework. We begin with an introduction of the classical formulation of the forward and reverse processes in the original denoising diffusion probabilistic model (DDPM, [ 26 ] ), which defines the basic mechanism of gradually adding and removing noise. Building on that, we then introduce refinements that are central to our implementation.
paragraphs.zh: 扩散模型为这项工作奠定了基础，在本节中，我们将对底层框架进行简要概述。 我们首先介绍原始去噪扩散概率模型（DDPM，[26]）中前向和反向过程的经典表述，该表述定义了逐步添加和移除噪声的基本机制。 在此基础上，我们接着介绍我们实现中的核心改进。

sents.en: Diffusion models lay the foundation for this work, and in this section we provide a concise overview of the underlying framework.
sents.zh: 扩散模型为这项工作奠定了基础，在本节中，我们将对底层框架进行简要概述。

sents.en: We begin with an introduction of the classical formulation of the forward and reverse processes in the original denoising diffusion probabilistic model (DDPM, [ 26 ] ), which defines the basic mechanism of gradually adding and removing noise.
sents.zh: 我们首先介绍原始去噪扩散概率模型（DDPM，[26]）中前向和反向过程的经典表述，该表述定义了逐步添加和移除噪声的基本机制。

sents.en: Building on that, we then introduce refinements that are central to our implementation.
sents.zh: 在此基础上，我们接着介绍我们实现中的核心改进。

paragraphs.en: In the classical DDPM, the generative process is defined by a pair of Markov chains: a forward noising process that gradually perturbs clean data into noise, and a reverse denoising process that gradually removes noise to recover clean samples.
paragraphs.zh: 在经典的 DDPM 中，生成过程由一对马尔可夫链定义：一个前向加噪过程，逐步将干净数据扰动为噪声；以及一个反向去噪过程，逐步去除噪声以恢复干净样本。

paragraphs.en: The forward diffusion process systematically corrupts clean data with Gaussian noise and is only used during training. Starting from an unperturbed image 𝐱 0 : = 𝐱 \mathbf{x}_{0}\mathrel{\mathop{:}}=\mathbf{x} , Gaussian noise is gradually injected over a fixed number of steps t ∈ { 1 , 2 , ⋯ , T } t\in\{1,2,\cdots,T\} . paragraphs.en: Whereas DDPM reverse process defines a stochastic Markov chain with Gaussian noise injected at every denoising step, [ 62 ] introduced Denoising Diffusion Implicit Models (DDIM): a deterministic, non-Markovian sampling procedure that uses the same trained denoising network but eliminates per-step noise injection. DDIM also preserves the same distribution of 𝐱 t \mathbf{x}_{t} at each timestep as DDPM, while enabling step-skipping and faster sampling.
paragraphs.zh: 与 DDPM 的逆过程在每次去噪步骤中注入高斯噪声以定义一个随机马尔可夫链不同，[ 62 ] 提出了去噪扩散隐式模型（DDIM）：一种确定性、非马尔可夫的采样方法，它使用相同的训练好的去噪网络，但消除了每一步的噪声注入。 DDIM 还保持了每个时间步中 𝐱 t \mathbf{x}_{t} 与 DDPM 相同的分布，同时支持跳步和更快的采样。

sents.en: Whereas DDPM reverse process defines a stochastic Markov chain with Gaussian noise injected at every denoising step, [ 62 ] introduced Denoising Diffusion Implicit Models (DDIM): a deterministic, non-Markovian sampling procedure that uses the same trained denoising network but eliminates per-step noise injection.
sents.zh: 与 DDPM 的逆过程在每次去噪步骤中注入高斯噪声以定义一个随机马尔可夫链不同，[ 62 ] 提出了去噪扩散隐式模型（DDIM）：一种确定性、非马尔可夫的采样方法，它使用相同的训练好的去噪网络，但消除了每一步的噪声注入。

sents.en: DDIM also preserves the same distribution of 𝐱 t \mathbf{x}_{t} at each timestep as DDPM, while enabling step-skipping and faster sampling.
sents.zh: DDIM 还保持了每个时间步中 𝐱 t \mathbf{x}_{t} 与 DDPM 相同的分布，同时支持跳步和更快的采样。

paragraphs.en: Since every noisy state can be expressed as a linear combination of the clean image 𝐱 0 \mathbf{x}_{0} and forward process added noise ϵ \epsilon , the key idea of DDIM is to use the network’s predicted noise f θ ​ ( 𝐱 t , t ) f_{\theta}(\mathbf{x}_{t},t) to estimate the clean image 𝐱 ^ 0 \hat{\mathbf{x}}_{0} (via Equation A5 ) and then recompose a less noisy state 𝐱 s \mathbf{x}_{s} at any earlier timestep s < t s<t :
paragraphs.zh: 由于每个含噪声的状态都可以表示为干净图像 𝐱 0 \mathbf{x}_{0} 与前向过程添加的噪声 ϵ \epsilon 的线性组合，因此 DDIM 的核心思想是利用网络预测的噪声 f θ ​ ( 𝐱 t , t ) f_{\theta}(\mathbf{x}_{t},t) 来估计干净图像 𝐱 ^ 0 \hat{\mathbf{x}}_{0}（通过方程 A5），然后在任意更早的时间步 s < t s<t 处重新合成一个噪声更少的状态 𝐱 s \mathbf{x}_{s}：

paragraphs.en: This update rule differs from the DDPM ( Equation A6 ) in that no additional Gaussian noise is injected. As a result, the reverse trajectory from noise to data becomes deterministic and randomness comes from the initial noise only.
paragraphs.zh: 该更新规则与 DDPM（方程 A6）的不同之处在于，它不会注入任何额外的高斯噪声。 因此，从噪声到数据的反向轨迹变为确定性的，而随机性仅来自初始噪声。

sents.en: This update rule differs from the DDPM ( Equation A6 ) in that no additional Gaussian noise is injected.
sents.zh: 该更新规则与 DDPM（方程 A6）的不同之处在于，它不会注入任何额外的高斯噪声。

sents.en: As a result, the reverse trajectory from noise to data becomes deterministic and randomness comes from the initial noise only.
sents.zh: 因此，从噪声到数据的反向轨迹变为确定性的，而随机性仅来自初始噪声。

paragraphs.en: In practice, this deterministic formulation allows subsampling of timesteps. Instead of performing the full chain of T ∼ 1000 T\sim 1000 steps in DDPM, one may select a coarser sequence of K ≪ T K\ll T steps (e.g., K ≈ 50 K\approx 50 ) and apply the DDIM update rule, substantially reducing the cost of generation while maintaining sample quality.

paragraphs.en: Applying diffusion directly in pixel space is computationally demanding, as high-dimensional images require large memory and long training times. In addition, pixel space encodes redundant high-frequency variations and sensor noise that are perceptually uninformative, forcing the model to waste capacity on irrelevant details.
paragraphs.zh: 直接在像素空间应用扩散模型会带来巨大的计算负担，因为高维图像需要大量内存和较长的训练时间。 此外，像素空间编码了感知上无用的冗余高频变化和传感器噪声，迫使模型将容量浪费在无关细节上。

sents.en: Applying diffusion directly in pixel space is computationally demanding, as high-dimensional images require large memory and long training times.
sents.zh: 直接在像素空间应用扩散模型会带来巨大的计算负担，因为高维图像需要大量内存和较长的训练时间。

sents.en: In addition, pixel space encodes redundant high-frequency variations and sensor noise that are perceptually uninformative, forcing the model to waste capacity on irrelevant details.
sents.zh: 此外，像素空间编码了感知上无用的冗余高频变化和传感器噪声，迫使模型将容量浪费在无关细节上。

paragraphs.en: To address these challenges, Latent Diffusion Models (LDM; [ 54 ] ) first compress images into a lower-dimensional latent space using a variational autoencoder (VAE; [ 37 ] ), and then perform the forward and reverse diffusion process in that latent space. A VAE is an encoder-decoder structure: the encoder ℰ \mathcal{E} maps input images 𝐱 \mathbf{x} into a compressed latent representation 𝐳 = ℰ ⁡ ( 𝐱 ) \mathbf{z}=\mathcal{E}(\mathbf{x}) , and the decoder 𝒟 \mathcal{D} reconstructs the image from its latent 𝐱 ^ = 𝒟 ⁡ ( 𝐳 ) \hat{\mathbf{x}}=\mathcal{D}(\mathbf{z}) . The autoencoder is trained independently first using reconstruction loss and regularization, ensuring that the latent representation preserves semantic content while remaining smooth.
paragraphs.zh: 为了解决这些挑战，潜在扩散模型（LDM；[ 54 ]）首先使用变分自编码器（VAE；[ 37 ]）将图像压缩到低维的潜在空间中，然后在该潜在空间中进行前向和反向扩散过程。 VAE 是一种编码器-解码器结构：编码器 ℰ \mathcal{E} 将输入图像 𝐱 \mathbf{x} 映射为压缩后的潜在表示 𝐳 = ℰ ⁡ ( 𝐱 ) \mathbf{z}=\mathcal{E}(\mathbf{x})，而解码器 𝒟 \mathcal{D} 则从潜在表示中重建图像 𝐱 ^ = 𝒟 ⁡ ( 𝐳 ) \hat{\mathbf{x}}=\mathcal{D}(\mathbf{z})。 自编码器首先使用重建损失和正则化进行独立训练，以确保潜在表示在保持平滑的同时保留语义内容。

paragraphs.en: This latent diffusion formulation combines the representational power of autoencoders with the generative flexibility of diffusion models. By shifting the diffusion process into a compressed latent space, it reduces computational cost, improves scalability to high-resolution data, and enhances model’s knowledge on semantically meaningful information. As a result, LDMs achieve better efficiency and robustness, making it a good foundation for MAGiDiff .
paragraphs.zh: 这种潜在扩散公式将自编码器的表示能力与扩散模型的生成灵活性相结合。 通过将扩散过程转移到压缩的潜在空间中，它降低了计算成本，提升了对高分辨率数据的可扩展性，并增强了模型对语义有意义信息的理解。 因此，LDM 实现了更高的效率和更强的鲁棒性，使其成为 MAGiDiff 的良好基础。

paragraphs.en: The evaluations presented in Section IV.4 use one realization per input in order to compare MAGiDiff directly with the deterministic regression baseline. However, as a conditional diffusion model, MAGiDiff encodes a distribution of plausible magnetograms and is inherently stochastic: for a fixed UV/EUV conditioning input, different initial noise can yield different realizations drawn from the learned distribution. In this section, we examine this distribution through qualitative comparisons of independent realizations and a quantitative best-of- k k analysis.
paragraphs.zh: 第 IV.4 节中展示的评价对每个输入仅使用一次实现，以便将 MAGiDiff 与确定性回归基线直接进行比较。 然而，作为一种条件扩散模型，MAGiDiff 编码了可信磁图的分布，并且本质上具有随机性：对于固定的 UV/EUV 条件输入，不同的初始噪声可能会产生从已学习分布中抽取的不同实现。 在本节中，我们通过独立实现的定性比较以及定量最佳-k分析来研究这种分布。

sents.zh: 第 IV.4 节中展示的评价对每个输入仅使用一次实现，以便将 MAGiDiff 与确定性回归基线直接进行比较。

sents.en: However, as a conditional diffusion model, MAGiDiff encodes a distribution of plausible magnetograms and is inherently stochastic: for a fixed UV/EUV conditioning input, different initial noise can yield different realizations drawn from the learned distribution.
sents.zh: 然而，作为一种条件扩散模型，MAGiDiff 编码了可信磁图的分布，并且本质上具有随机性：对于固定的 UV/EUV 条件输入，不同的初始噪声可能会产生从已学习分布中抽取的不同实现。

sents.en: In this section, we examine this distribution through qualitative comparisons of independent realizations and a quantitative best-of- k k analysis.
sents.zh: 在本节中，我们通过独立实现的定性比较以及定量最佳-k分析来研究这种分布。

paragraphs.en: We begin with qualitative comparison of these realizations to determine where magnetic structures remain consistent and where stochastic variations occur. Figure 17 shows three independent realizations drawn from the same UV/EUV observations. The realizations recover almost identical large scale magnetic structures and polarity across α ​ B R \alpha B_{R} , α ​ B ϕ \alpha B_{\phi} , and α ​ B θ \alpha B_{\theta} , indicating that the dominant magnetic structures are well constrained. Meanwhile, small differences appear in localized weak-field regions, reflecting the stochastic nature of diffusion sampling process. This behavior suggests that MAGiDiff does not produce arbitrary samples, but instead generates multiple plausible magnetograms that remain consistent in well-constrained regions while allowing variation when the signal is weak or uncertain.
paragraphs.zh: 我们首先对这些实现进行定性比较，以确定磁结构在哪些地方保持一致，以及在哪些地方出现随机变化。 图 17 展示了从相同的紫外/极紫外观测中获取的三个独立实现。 这些实现几乎完全恢复了相同的大尺度磁结构和极性，涵盖 α ​ B R \alpha B_{R} 、α ​ B ϕ \alpha B_{\phi} 和 α ​ B θ \alpha B_{\theta} ，表明主导的磁结构得到了很好的约束。 与此同时，在局部弱场区域出现了细微差异，这反映了扩散采样过程的随机性。 这种行为表明，MAGiDiff 并非生成任意的样本，而是能够产生多个合理的磁图：在约束良好的区域保持结果一致，而在信号较弱或不确定的区域允许存在变化。

paragraphs.en: Given this constrained variation across realizations, we next use a best-of- k k analysis to test whether drawing more samples increases the chance of obtaining a realization that more closely matches the Hinode /SOT-SP ground truth. paragraphs.en: This best-of- k k evaluation is not intended to represent normal inference, where the ground truth is unavailable. Rather, it is a controlled test of the learned predictive distribution: if MAGiDiff places probability mass near the ground truth magnetogram, then drawing more samples should increase the chance of obtaining a realization closer to the Hinode /SOT-SP ground truth. This trend is confirmed in Table 6 : increasing k k leads to consistent improvements in pixel-wise accuracy across all field components. In contrast, the distributional and structural metrics remain largely unchanged. These results indicate that additional sampling can increase the possibility of obtaining a realization that has better per-pixel correspondence with the Hinode /SOT-SP observation while keeping the overall pixel-value distribution, sharpness, and spectral characteristics. Together with Figure 17 , these results show that stochastic variations among realizations permit generalization of multiple slightly different yet distributionally and structurally constrained magnetograms.

paragraphs.en: To adapt MAGiDiff to EUV instruments other than SDO /AIA, we keep the learning problem fixed and handle instrumental differences during preprocessing. This preprocessing aims to bring each instrument’s EUV filtergrams into closer agreement with SDO /AIA filtergrams before fine-tuning. For each instrument, we first reproject all filtergrams onto a common grid and resample them to reduce pixel-resolution mismatch with SDO /AIA. We then calibrate the intensities to approximately the SDO /AIA range and set unavailable SDO /AIA channels to zero. The fine-tuned model therefore receives the same conditioning input: SDO /AIA-like EUV filtergrams, an on-disk mask, a heliographic latitude map, and a solar cycle indicator.
paragraphs.zh: 为了将 MAGiDiff 适配除 SDO /AIA 以外的其他 EUV 仪器，我们保持学习问题不变，并在预处理阶段处理仪器间的差异。 这种预处理旨在在微调之前，使每种仪器的 EUV 滤光图与 SDO /AIA 的滤光图更加一致。 对于每种仪器，我们首先将所有滤光图重投影到一个共同的网格上，并对它们进行重采样，以减少与 SDO /AIA 的像素分辨率不匹配问题。 接着，我们将强度校准至大致与 SDO /AIA 的范围一致，并将 SDO /AIA 中不可用的通道设为零。 因此，微调后的模型会接收到相同的条件输入：类 SDO /AIA 的 EUV 滤光图、一个日面掩膜、一个日面纬度图以及一个太阳周期指示器。

paragraphs.en: Since Hinode /SOT-SP does not co-observe STEREO /EUVI or GOES /SUVI densely enough for paired training, we use SuperSynthIA predictions as the target vector magnetograms. For each EUV observation, we take the nearest SuperSynthIA α ​ B R \alpha B_{R} , α ​ B ϕ \alpha B_{\phi} , α ​ B θ \alpha B_{\theta} maps and reproject them onto the corresponding EUV filtergram grid. Because SuperSynthIA follows SDO /HMI α ​ B θ \alpha B_{\theta} sign convention, a flip on SuperSynthIA α ​ B θ \alpha B_{\theta} sign is necessary after reprojection to match the Hinode /SOT-SP convention used by the pretrained MAGiDiff .

paragraphs.en: Fine-tuning proceeds in two stages. We first fine-tune the VAE on 256 × 256 256\times 256 pixel SuperSynthIA vector magnetogram crops so that its latent space is adapted to SuperSynthIA predictions rather than Hinode /SOT-SP magnetograms. This corresponds to approximately 153 ​ ″ × 153 ​ ″ 153\arcsec\times 153\arcsec . We then load the pretrained denoising U-Net, replace the original VAE with the SuperSynthIA fine-tuned VAE, reset the optimizer, and fine-tune on instrument-specific pairs of EUV filtergrams and target magnetograms using 512 × 512 512\times 512 pixel crops, corresponding to approximately 306 ​ ″ × 306 ​ ″ 306\arcsec\times 306\arcsec , while keeping the VAE frozen. Otherwise, the denoising training setup is unchanged.
paragraphs.zh: 微调分为两个阶段进行。 我们首先对 256 × 256 像素的 SuperSynthIA 矢量磁图裁剪图像进行 VAE 微调，使其潜在空间适应 SuperSynthIA 的预测结果，而非 Hinode /SOT-SP 磁图。 这大约对应于 153 ″ × 153 ″（153\arcsec\times 153\arcsec）。 接着，我们加载预训练的降噪 U-Net，将原始 VAE 替换为经过 SuperSynthIA 微调的 VAE，重置优化器，并使用 512 × 512 像素（512\times 512）的裁剪图像，在仪器特定的 EUV 滤光图与目标磁图配对数据上进行微调，这大约对应于 306 ″ × 306 ″（306\arcsec\times 306\arcsec），同时保持 VAE 冻结不变。 除此之外，降噪训练的设置保持不变。

paragraphs.en: During fine-tuning, we also use a sign-flip augmentation analogous to the one used in the cross solar cycle generalization test in Section IV.6 . With probability 0.5 0.5 , the target vector magnetogram is multiplied by − 1 -1 and the solar cycle indicator is changed from the current cycle parity to the opposite parity, while the EUV filtergrams and latitude map remain unchanged. This augmentation is included because instrument-specific fine-tuning datasets are relatively small and may not span multiple solar cycles. The remaining preprocessing is instrument specific.
paragraphs.zh: 在微调过程中，我们还使用了一种符号翻转增强方法，该方法与第 IV.6 节中交叉太阳周期泛化测试所使用的方法类似。 以 0.5 的概率，将目标矢量磁图乘以 -1，并将太阳周期指示器从当前周期的奇偶性改为相反的奇偶性，而 EUV 滤光图和纬度图则保持不变。 之所以包含这种增强方法，是因为特定仪器的微调数据集相对较小，可能无法覆盖多个太阳周期。 其余的前处理步骤均为仪器特定的处理。

paragraphs.en: Intuitively, directly applying MAGiDiff trained on SDO /AIA data to STEREO /EUVI filtergrams will not work due to instrumental differences in field of view, optical resolution, calibration, and degradation. We therefore make several adjustments before fine-tuning. We use data from 2022 to 2024 to construct the fine-tuning dataset because during this period STEREO-A /EUVI is near Earth and has substantial field-of-view overlap with SDO /HMI. This overlap is essential because we use SuperSynthIA predictions as the target vector magnetograms, and SDO /HMI stokes observations are the input to SuperSynthIA.
paragraphs.zh: 直观地说，由于视场、光学分辨率、定标和退化方面的仪器差异，直接将基于 SDO /AIA 数据训练的 MAGiDiff 应用于 STEREO /EUVI 滤光图是行不通的。 因此，在微调之前，我们进行了多项调整。 我们使用 2022 年至 2024 年的数据来构建微调数据集，因为在此期间 STEREO-A /EUVI 靠近地球，并且与 SDO /HMI 存在显著的视场重叠。 这种重叠至关重要，因为我们使用 SuperSynthIA 的预测结果作为目标矢量磁图，而 SDO /HMI 的斯托克斯观测数据则是 SuperSynthIA 的输入。

paragraphs.en: For the fine-tuning dataset, we use 171 171 Å, 195 195 Å, and 304 304 Å channels because they are the STEREO /EUVI passbands that overlap with SDO /AIA passbands. We sample candidate times at a 4 4 -hour cadence and, because these channels are observed asynchronously on STEREO /EUVI, retain only timestamps for which all three channels are available within 5 5 minutes. Raw Level- 0.5 0.5 FITS files are calibrated to Level- 1 1 with SECCHI_PREP pipeline in SolarSoft package [ 14 ] , which applies bias subtraction, flat-field correction, and are converted to physical units DN s − 1 \text{\,}\mathrm{DN}\text{\,}{\mathrm{s}}^{-1} . We then reproject the 195 195 Å and 304 304 Å maps onto the 171 171 Å coordinate frame and bilinearly upsample the resulting maps by a factor of 2.67 × 2.67\times to match SDO /AIA’s angular pixel scale. We then reproject the SuperSynthIA vector magnetograms onto this upsampled grid. After filtering for valid paired full-disk EUV filtergrams and SuperSynthIA vector magnetograms, the STEREO /EUVI fine-tuning dataset contains 4949 4949 pairs. We split these data temporally: 2022 2022 January through 2023 2023 June for training ( 2938 2938 pairs), 2023 2023 July through December for validation ( 523 523 pairs), and 2024 2024 April through December for testing ( 1488 1488 pairs).
paragraphs.zh: 对于微调数据集，我们使用 171 Å、195 Å 和 304 Å 通道，因为这些通道是 STEREO /EUVI 的波段与 SDO /AIA 的波段重叠的部分。 我们以 4 小时的时间间隔采样候选时刻，并且由于这些通道在 STEREO /EUVI 上并非同步观测，因此仅保留所有三个通道在 5 分钟内均可用的时间戳。 原始 Level-0.5 FITS 文件通过 SolarSoft 软件包中的 SECCHI_PREP 处理流程校准为 Level-1，该流程执行了偏置扣除、平场校正，并将其转换为物理单位 DN s⁻¹。 随后，我们将 195 Å 和 304 Å 的图像重投影到 171 Å 的坐标框架中，并对生成的图像进行 2.67 倍的雙線性上采样，以匹配 SDO /AIA 的角度像素尺度。 接着，我们将 SuperSynthIA 矢量磁图重投影到这个经过上采样的网格上。 在筛选出有效配对的完整日面 EUV 滤光图像和 SuperSynthIA 矢量磁图后，STEREO /EUVI 微调数据集包含 4949 对数据。 我们从时间上将这些数据划分为：2022 年 1 月至 2023 年 6 月用于训练（2938 对），2023 年 7 月至 12 月用于验证（523 对），以及 2024 年 4 月至 12 月用于测试（1488 对）。

paragraphs.en: The main STEREO /EUVI-specific challenge is photometric mismatch. The paired STEREO /EUVI– SDO /AIA intensity distributions are not well matched by a single affine correction, especially in the bright active-region and low-intensity tails. This mismatch is further complicated by long-term STEREO /EUVI degradation: the SECCHI_PREP pipeline calibrates the raw data to Level-1, but it does not fully remove long-term changes in instrument sensitivity, so the STEREO /EUVI intensity distribution can vary substantially over the mission. We therefore use a time-varying quantile mapping in log ⁡ ( 1 + x ) \log(1+x) space. The mapping is estimated from about 10 10 calibration pairs per available month from 2011 2011 through 2025 2025 . Each pair consists of STEREO /EUVI and SDO /AIA observations taken close in time. We exclude September 2014 through November 2015 because STEREO-A /EUVI was in solar conjunction and data are unavailable. This leaves 1606 1606 calibration pairs. For each pair, the on-disk pixels are sorted by intensity separately for STEREO /EUVI and SDO /AIA. The 0 0 th, 1 1 st, …, 100 100 th percentiles of these sorted intensity values are then recorded for each STEREO /EUVI-to-aia channel pair ( STEREO /EUVI 171 171 Å → \rightarrow SDO /AIA 171 171 Å, STEREO /EUVI 195 195 Å → \rightarrow SDO /AIA 193 193 Å, and STEREO /EUVI 304 304 Å → \rightarrow SDO /AIA 304 304 Å). These percentiles form the raw calibration anchors for the lookup table by matching intensity values at the same percentile rank in the two instruments. For example, if the median on-disk STEREO /EUVI 195 195 Å intensity in a calibration pair is x x and the median on-disk SDO /AIA 193 193 Å intensity in the corresponding SDO /AIA filtergram is y y , then the 50 50 th-percentile anchor maps x ↦ y x\mapsto y . The same procedure is applied to all percentiles, so the mapping matches the full intensity distribution.
paragraphs.zh: STEREO /EUVI 面临的主要挑战是光度不匹配。 成对的 STEREO /EUVI–SDO /AIA 强度分布无法通过单一的仿射校正很好地匹配，尤其是在明亮的活动区和低强度尾部区域。 这种不匹配因 STEREO /EUVI 的长期性能退化而进一步复杂化：SECCHI_PREP 处理流程虽将原始数据校准至一级数据，但未能完全消除仪器灵敏度的长期变化，因此 STEREO /EUVI 的强度分布在整个任务期间可能显著变化。 因此，我们在 log(1+x) 空间中使用随时间变化的分位数映射。 该映射基于 2011 年至 2025 年间每月可用的约 10^10 个校准对进行估算。 每个校准对由时间上接近的 STEREO /EUVI 和 SDO /AIA 观测数据组成。 我们排除了 2014 年 9 月至 2015 年 11 月的数据，因为在此期间 STEREO-A /EUVI 处于太阳合相状态，数据不可用。 这样便剩下 1606 个校准对。 对于每个校准对，将星盘上的像素按强度分别对 STEREO /EUVI 和 SDO /AIA 进行排序。 随后记录这些排序强度值的第 0、第 1、…、第 100 分位数，以覆盖每个 STEREO /EUVI 到 AIA 的通道对（STEREO /EUVI 171 Å → SDO /AIA 171 Å、STEREO /EUVI 195 Å → SDO /AIA 193 Å，以及 STEREO /EUVI 304 Å → SDO /AIA 304 Å）。 这些分位数构成了查找表的原始校准锚点，通过匹配两种仪器中相同分位数排名处的强度值来实现。 例如，若某个校准对中 STEREO /EUVI 195 Å 的星盘强度中位数为 x，而对应 SDO /AIA 滤光图中的 SDO /AIA 193 Å 强度中位数为 y，则第 50 分位数锚点将 x 映射到 y（x ↦ y）。 同样的流程适用于所有分位数，从而确保该映射能够匹配完整的强度分布。

sents.en: The main STEREO /EUVI-specific challenge is photometric mismatch.
sents.zh: STEREO /EUVI 面临的主要挑战是光度不匹配。

sents.en: The paired STEREO /EUVI– SDO /AIA intensity distributions are not well matched by a single affine correction, especially in the bright active-region and low-intensity tails.
sents.zh: 成对的 STEREO /EUVI–SDO /AIA 强度分布无法通过单一的仿射校正很好地匹配，尤其是在明亮的活动区和低强度尾部区域。

sents.en: This mismatch is further complicated by long-term STEREO /EUVI degradation: the SECCHI_PREP pipeline calibrates the raw data to Level-1, but it does not fully remove long-term changes in instrument sensitivity, so the STEREO /EUVI intensity distribution can vary substantially over the mission.
sents.zh: 这种不匹配因 STEREO /EUVI 的长期性能退化而进一步复杂化：SECCHI_PREP 处理流程虽将原始数据校准至一级数据，但未能完全消除仪器灵敏度的长期变化，因此 STEREO /EUVI 的强度分布在整个任务期间可能显著变化。

sents.en: We therefore use a time-varying quantile mapping in log ⁡ ( 1 + x ) \log(1+x) space.
sents.zh: 因此，我们在 log(1+x) 空间中使用随时间变化的分位数映射。

sents.en: The mapping is estimated from about 10 10 calibration pairs per available month from 2011 2011 through 2025 2025 .
sents.zh: 该映射基于 2011 年至 2025 年间每月可用的约 10^10 个校准对进行估算。

sents.en: Each pair consists of STEREO /EUVI and SDO /AIA observations taken close in time.
sents.zh: 每个校准对由时间上接近的 STEREO /EUVI 和 SDO /AIA 观测数据组成。

sents.en: We exclude September 2014 through November 2015 because STEREO-A /EUVI was in solar conjunction and data are unavailable.
sents.zh: 我们排除了 2014 年 9 月至 2015 年 11 月的数据，因为在此期间 STEREO-A /EUVI 处于太阳合相状态，数据不可用。

sents.en: This leaves 1606 1606 calibration pairs.
sents.zh: 这样便剩下 1606 个校准对。

sents.en: For each pair, the on-disk pixels are sorted by intensity separately for STEREO /EUVI and SDO /AIA.
sents.zh: 对于每个校准对，将星盘上的像素按强度分别对 STEREO /EUVI 和 SDO /AIA 进行排序。

sents.en: The 0 0 th, 1 1 st, …, 100 100 th percentiles of these sorted intensity values are then recorded for each STEREO /EUVI-to-aia channel pair ( STEREO /EUVI 171 171 Å → \rightarrow SDO /AIA 171 171 Å, STEREO /EUVI 195 195 Å → \rightarrow SDO /AIA 193 193 Å, and STEREO /EUVI 304 304 Å → \rightarrow SDO /AIA 304 304 Å).
sents.zh: 随后记录这些排序强度值的第 0、第 1、…、第 100 分位数，以覆盖每个 STEREO /EUVI 到 AIA 的通道对（STEREO /EUVI 171 Å → SDO /AIA 171 Å、STEREO /EUVI 195 Å → SDO /AIA 193 Å，以及 STEREO /EUVI 304 Å → SDO /AIA 304 Å）。

sents.en: These percentiles form the raw calibration anchors for the lookup table by matching intensity values at the same percentile rank in the two instruments.
sents.zh: 这些分位数构成了查找表的原始校准锚点，通过匹配两种仪器中相同分位数排名处的强度值来实现。

sents.en: For example, if the median on-disk STEREO /EUVI 195 195 Å intensity in a calibration pair is x x and the median on-disk SDO /AIA 193 193 Å intensity in the corresponding SDO /AIA filtergram is y y , then the 50 50 th-percentile anchor maps x ↦ y x\mapsto y .
sents.zh: 例如，若某个校准对中 STEREO /EUVI 195 Å 的星盘强度中位数为 x，而对应 SDO /AIA 滤光图中的 SDO /AIA 193 Å 强度中位数为 y，则第 50 分位数锚点将 x 映射到 y（x ↦ y）。

sents.en: The same procedure is applied to all percentiles, so the mapping matches the full intensity distribution.
sents.zh: 同样的流程适用于所有分位数，从而确保该映射能够匹配完整的强度分布。

paragraphs.en: The calibration anchors are grouped into semiannual time bins. Within each bin and each channel pair, the matched percentile values are median-aggregated to form a stable lookup curve from STEREO /EUVI intensity to SDO /AIA intensity. The curves are smoothed with a three-bin rolling median, and monotonicity is enforced. This produces a lookup curve with 101 101 breakpoints.
paragraphs.zh: 校准锚点被分组为半年时间区间。 在每个区间和每个通道对中，匹配的百分位数值通过中位数聚合，形成一条从 STEREO /EUVI 强度到 SDO /AIA 强度的稳定查找曲线。 这些曲线使用三区间滚动中位数进行平滑处理，并强制保持单调性。 这样便生成了一条具有 101×101 个断点的查找曲线。

sents.en: The calibration anchors are grouped into semiannual time bins.
sents.zh: 校准锚点被分组为半年时间区间。

sents.en: Within each bin and each channel pair, the matched percentile values are median-aggregated to form a stable lookup curve from STEREO /EUVI intensity to SDO /AIA intensity.
sents.zh: 在每个区间和每个通道对中，匹配的百分位数值通过中位数聚合，形成一条从 STEREO /EUVI 强度到 SDO /AIA 强度的稳定查找曲线。

sents.en: The curves are smoothed with a three-bin rolling median, and monotonicity is enforced.
sents.zh: 这些曲线使用三区间滚动中位数进行平滑处理，并强制保持单调性。

sents.en: This produces a lookup curve with 101 101 breakpoints.
sents.zh: 这样便生成了一条具有 101×101 个断点的查找曲线。

paragraphs.en: To map a STEREO /EUVI intensity value, we first apply log ⁡ ( 1 + x ) \log(1+x) and then linearly interpolate between the neighboring breakpoints, using linear extrapolation for values outside the stored breakpoint range. This places the STEREO /EUVI values on the same log ⁡ ( 1 + x ) \log(1+x) intensity scale as the SDO /AIA inputs used to pretrain MAGiDiff . After this transform, training proceeds with standard SDO /AIA normalization.
paragraphs.zh: 为了对 STEREO /EUVI 的强度值进行映射，我们首先应用 log ⁡ ( 1 + x ) \log(1+x) 函数，然后在相邻的断点之间进行线性插值；对于超出已存储断点范围的值，则使用线性外推法。 这样处理可以将 STEREO /EUVI 的值置于与用于预训练 MAGiDiff 的 SDO /AIA 输入相同的 log ⁡ ( 1 + x ) \log(1+x) 强度标度上。 完成此转换后，训练过程将采用标准的 SDO /AIA 归一化方法继续执行。

sents.en: To map a STEREO /EUVI intensity value, we first apply log ⁡ ( 1 + x ) \log(1+x) and then linearly interpolate between the neighboring breakpoints, using linear extrapolation for values outside the stored breakpoint range.
sents.zh: 为了对 STEREO /EUVI 的强度值进行映射，我们首先应用 log ⁡ ( 1 + x ) \log(1+x) 函数，然后在相邻的断点之间进行线性插值；对于超出已存储断点范围的值，则使用线性外推法。

sents.en: This places the STEREO /EUVI values on the same log ⁡ ( 1 + x ) \log(1+x) intensity scale as the SDO /AIA inputs used to pretrain MAGiDiff .
sents.zh: 这样处理可以将 STEREO /EUVI 的值置于与用于预训练 MAGiDiff 的 SDO /AIA 输入相同的 log ⁡ ( 1 + x ) \log(1+x) 强度标度上。

sents.en: After this transform, training proceeds with standard SDO /AIA normalization.
sents.zh: 完成此转换后，训练过程将采用标准的 SDO /AIA 归一化方法继续执行。

paragraphs.en: This correction reduces the dominant distribution shift associated STEREO /EUVI degradation, but it does not make the model equally reliable at all observation times. Because the fine-tuning dataset is restricted to observation from 2022 2022 through 2024 2024 , when STEREO-A /EUVI has substantial overlap with SDO /HMI, we expect the fine-tuned MAGiDiff model to be most reliable near this time range. Applying the model to much earlier STEREO /EUVI observations may therefore require additional adjustment, either by extending the fine-tuning dataset to earlier observations or by improving the calibration for long-term STEREO /EUVI intensity changes.
paragraphs.zh: 这种修正减少了与 STEREO /EUVI 性能退化相关的主要分布偏移，但并未使模型在所有观测时间点上都具有同等可靠性。 由于微调数据集仅限于 2022 年至 2024 年的观测数据，而在此期间 STEREO-A /EUVI 与 SDO /HMI 的数据存在显著重叠，因此我们预计经过微调的 MAGiDiff 模型在该时间段附近最为可靠。 因此，将该模型应用于更早的 STEREO /EUVI 观测数据可能需要额外调整，方法包括将微调数据集扩展到更早的观测数据，或改进对 STEREO /EUVI 长期强度变化的校准。

sents.en: This correction reduces the dominant distribution shift associated STEREO /EUVI degradation, but it does not make the model equally reliable at all observation times.
sents.zh: 这种修正减少了与 STEREO /EUVI 性能退化相关的主要分布偏移，但并未使模型在所有观测时间点上都具有同等可靠性。

sents.en: Because the fine-tuning dataset is restricted to observation from 2022 2022 through 2024 2024 , when STEREO-A /EUVI has substantial overlap with SDO /HMI, we expect the fine-tuned MAGiDiff model to be most reliable near this time range.
sents.zh: 由于微调数据集仅限于 2022 年至 2024 年的观测数据，而在此期间 STEREO-A /EUVI 与 SDO /HMI 的数据存在显著重叠，因此我们预计经过微调的 MAGiDiff 模型在该时间段附近最为可靠。

sents.en: Applying the model to much earlier STEREO /EUVI observations may therefore require additional adjustment, either by extending the fine-tuning dataset to earlier observations or by improving the calibration for long-term STEREO /EUVI intensity changes.
sents.zh: 因此，将该模型应用于更早的 STEREO /EUVI 观测数据可能需要额外调整，方法包括将微调数据集扩展到更早的观测数据，或改进对 STEREO /EUVI 长期强度变化的校准。

paragraphs.en: We quantify the fine-tuned MAGiDiff performance on the held out test set in Table 7 , using SuperSynthIA as the reference.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在表 7 中量化了基于 SuperSynthIA 作为参考的、在预留测试集上微调后的 MAGiDiff 性能。

paragraphs.en: As a second cross-instrument adaption test, we fine-tune MAGiDiff on the Solar Ultraviolet Imager (SUVI) onboard GOES–16 /SUVI and GOES–18 /SUVI.
paragraphs.zh: 作为第二次跨仪器适配测试，我们在 GOES–16 /SUVI 和 GOES–18 /SUVI 搭载的太阳紫外成像仪（SUVI）上对 MAGiDiff 进行了微调。

paragraphs.en: For the fine-tuning dataset, we use 94 94 Å, 131 131 Å, 171 171 Å, 195 195 Å, and 304 304 Å channels since they are the passbands that overlap with SDO /AIA passbands. We sample the Level-2 FITS products at a 4 4 -hour cadence and require all selected channels to be observed within 10 10 minutes from each other. For each timestamp, the five GOES /SUVI filtergrams are coaligned to the 171 171 Å coordinate frame and then bilinearly upsampled by 4.17 × 4.17\times to match SDO /AIA’s angular pixel scale. We then reproject the SuperSynthIA vector magnetograms onto the upsampled GOES /SUVI grid.
paragraphs.zh: 对于微调数据集，我们使用 94 94 Å、131 131 Å、171 171 Å、195 195 Å 和 304 304 Å 通道，因为这些通道是与 SDO /AIA 通带重叠的通过带。 我们以 4 4 小时的采样间隔对 Level-2 FITS 产品进行采样，并要求所有选定的通道在彼此 10 10 分钟之内被观测到。 对于每个时间戳，五个 GOES /SUVI 滤光图都被对齐到 171 171 Å 坐标框架中，然后通过双线性插值以 4.17 × 4.17\times 的比例上采样，以匹配 SDO /AIA 的角像素尺度。 接着，我们将 SuperSynthIA 矢量磁图重新投影到经过上采样的 GOES /SUVI 网格上。

paragraphs.en: The fine-tuning dataset spans 2022 2022 through 2024 2024 and contains 7475 7475 data pairs across GOES–16 /SUVI and GOES–18 /SUVI. After filtering, the train/validation/test datasets contain 3160 3160 / 1231 1231 / 2208 2208 samples. As in the STEREO /EUVI fine-tuning experiment, we split the data temporally: 2022 2022 January through 2023 2023 June for training, 2023 2023 July through December for validation, and 2024 2024 April through December for testing.
paragraphs.zh: 微调数据集的时间跨度为 2022 年至 2024 年，包含来自 GOES–16 /SUVI 和 GOES–18 /SUVI 的 7475 个数据对。 经过筛选后，训练集/验证集/测试集分别包含 3160 / 1231 / 2208 个样本。 与 STEREO /EUVI 微调实验一样，我们对数据进行了时间划分：2022 年 1 月至 2023 年 6 月用于训练，2023 年 7 月至 12 月用于验证，2024 年 4 月至 12 月用于测试。

paragraphs.en: We use the calibrated Level-2 products directly and normalize the inputs in log ⁡ ( 1 + x ) \log(1+x) space. Since the two satellites are not fully intercalibrated, we compute separate per-channel means and standard deviations for GOES–16 /SUVI and GOES–18 /SUVI. Fine-tuning is then performed on combined data pairs from both satellites, with each sample normalized using the parameters for its source satellite.
paragraphs.zh: 我们直接使用经过校准的 Level-2 产品，并将输入数据在 log ⁡ ( 1 + x ) \log(1+x) 空间中进行归一化。 由于两颗卫星尚未完全相互校准，因此我们为 GOES–16 /SUVI 和 GOES–18 /SUVI 分别计算每个通道的均值和标准差。 随后，我们对来自两颗卫星的联合数据对进行微调，其中每个样本均使用其来源卫星的参数进行归一化。
